title: Dasha and Puzzle
statementMd:
Dasha decided to have a rest after solving the problem. She had been ready to start her favourite activity — origami, but remembered the puzzle that she could not solve.

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/993f9826045f00eab45061e07146e461060398df.png)

The tree is a non-oriented connected graph without cycles. In particular, there always are $*n* - 1$ edges in a tree with $*n*$ vertices.

The puzzle is to position the vertices at the points of the Cartesian plane with integral coordinates, so that the segments between the vertices connected by edges are parallel to the coordinate axes. Also, the intersection of segments is allowed only at their ends. Distinct vertices should be placed at different points.

Help Dasha to find any suitable way to position the tree vertices on the plane.

It is guaranteed that if it is possible to position the tree vertices on the plane without violating the condition which is given above, then you can do it by using points with integral coordinates which don't exceed $10^{18}$ in absolute value.

## Input

The first line contains single integer $*n*$ $(1 ≤ *n* ≤ 30)$ — the number of vertices in the tree.

Each of next $*n* - 1$ lines contains two integers $*u*_{*i*}$, $*v*_{*i*}$ ($1 ≤ *u*_{*i*}, *v*_{*i*} ≤ *n*$) that mean that the $*i*$-th edge of the tree connects vertices $*u*_{*i*}$ and $*v*_{*i*}$.

It is guaranteed that the described graph is a tree.

## Output

If the puzzle doesn't have a solution then in the only line print "`NO`".

Otherwise, the first line should contain "`YES`". The next $*n*$ lines should contain the pair of integers $*x*_{*i*}$, $*y*_{*i*}$ $(|*x*_{*i*}|, |*y*_{*i*}| ≤ 10^{18})$ — the coordinates of the point which corresponds to the $*i*$-th vertex of the tree.

If there are several solutions, print any of them.

## Note

In the first sample one of the possible positions of tree is: ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/e6990dc13943fd5dfda8c2bff6b56c498af05f58.png)
statementZhMd:
达莎解决完题目后决定休息一下。她正准备开始自己最喜欢的活动——折纸，却想起了那道自己无法解决的拼图。

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/993f9826045f00eab45061e07146e461060398df.png)

树是一种无向无环连通图。特别地，一棵有 $*n*$ 个顶点的树总是有 $*n* - 1$ 条边。

这个拼图要求将各个顶点放置在笛卡尔平面的整点上，使得连接相邻顶点的线段都与坐标轴平行。此外，线段之间的交点只能是它们的端点。不同的顶点必须放置在不同的点上。

请帮助达莎找到一种将树的顶点放置在平面上的合法方案。

保证：如果能够在不违反上述条件的情况下将树的顶点放置在平面上，那么一定可以使用绝对值不超过 $10^{18}$ 的整点坐标完成放置。

## 输入格式

第一行包含一个整数 $*n*$ $(1 ≤ *n* ≤ 30)$，表示树的顶点数。

接下来的 $*n* - 1$ 行中，每行包含两个整数 $*u*_{*i*}$、$*v*_{*i*}$（$1 ≤ *u*_{*i*}, *v*_{*i*} ≤ *n*$），表示树中的第 $*i*$ 条边连接顶点 $*u*_{*i*}$ 和 $*v*_{*i*}$。

保证给出的图是一棵树。

## 输出格式

如果这个拼图没有解，只需在一行中输出 `NO`。

否则，第一行输出 `YES`。接下来的 $*n*$ 行中，每行应包含两个整数 $*x*_{*i*}$、$*y*_{*i*}$（$|*x*_{*i*}|, |*y*_{*i*}| ≤ 10^{18}$），表示树中第 $*i*$ 个顶点所对应点的坐标。

如果有多个解，输出任意一个即可。

## 说明

在第一个样例中，树的一种可能放置方式如下：![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/e6990dc13943fd5dfda8c2bff6b56c498af05f58.png)
